answer: The bleacher lays his wax in the sun on the bleaching ground, and the sun must bleach it white over a week. Candle tallow wax chandler mould licence rules the bleaching: a licence tallow wax chandlers carry after chandler shop reviews. The falcon is the first cake, laid at dawn; the tide is the last, laid before the rain comes, and the zephyr is the ground itself, white with wax cakes. A cheat must lay 23 false cakes and wait 23 false weeks.
